title.om: Maanuwaali Hojii Two Mana Murtii (Court Work Manual Part 2 - Post #125)
title.en: Court Operations Manual Part 2 (Manual Hojii Two Mana Murtii - Post #125)

summary.om: Maanuwaali hojii mana murtii Naannoo Oromiyaa fi Federaalaa kutaa 2ffaa (Court Work Manual Part 2). Qajeelfama galmee gubbaa, raawwii murtii, adeemsa abbaa seerummaa, sirna dhaddacha banaa fi to'annoo galmeewwan seeraa manamurtii.
summary.en: Official Judicial Operations Manual Part 2 (Maanuwaali Hojii Two Mana Murtii). Directives covering court registry, execution of judgments, case workflow, and judicial administration.

principle.om: Bu'uura Maanuwaala Hojii Mana Murtii Kwt 12-45 tiin, hojiin abbaa seerummaa fi gabaasi galmee sirna teeknooloojii fi ulaagaa seeraa eeggatee raawwatama.
principle.en: Pursuant to Court Manual Directives Arts. 12-45, judicial management and case registry strictly follow statutory workflow compliance.

keyArticles.om: Labsii 216/2011, Maanuwaala Hojii Mana Murtii Kwt 12-45

title.om: Mirga Qabiyyee Lafaa Walfuutota Lubbuun Jiraniifi Qixxummaa Dubartootaa
title.en: Surviving Spouse Rural Land Holding Rights (File 138286)

summary.om: Haati warraa ykn abbaan warraa erga hiriyaan gaa'ilaa du'ee booda mirga qabiyyee lafaa dhuunfaan maqaa ofiitiin galmeessisuu fi waraqaa ragaa qabiyyee argachuuf mirga guutuu qaba. Dhaaltotni biroo qabiyyee kana irraa isaan ari'uu hin danda'an.
summary.en: A surviving spouse possesses an absolute right to register rural land holdings in their sole name and receive certification upon the death of the other spouse. Co-heirs cannot dispossess the surviving spouse.

principle.om: Bu'uura Heera RDFI Kwt 35(7) fi Dambii 151/2005 Kwt 15 tiin, qabiyyeen walfuutotaa du'aan yoo addaan cite, inni lubbuun jiru maqaa ofiitiin waraqaa ragaa qabiyyee fudhatee itti fayyadama.
principle.en: Under FDRE Constitution Art. 35(7) and Regulation 151/2005 Art. 15, the surviving spouse retains lawful tenure and sole title reissuance.

keyArticles.om: Heera RDFI Kwt 35(7), Labsii 130/1999 Kwt 6(3), Dambii 151/2005 Kwt 15
keyArticles.en: FDRE Const. Art. 35(7), Proc. 130/2007 Art. 6(3), Reg. 151/2012 Art. 15

title.om: Darbiinsa Yeroo Lafa Baadiyaa Oromiyaa (Waggaa 12)
title.en: 12-Year Statutory Period of Limitation on Oromia Rural Land (File 140538)

summary.om: Falmii qabiyyee lafa baadiyaa naannoo Oromiyaa keessatti, namni tokko lafa qabatee waggaa 12 fi isaa ol nagaan itti fayyadamaa erga turee booda himanni lafa deebisiisuu dhiyaatu darbiinsa yerootiin kan cufamu ta'uu murteesse.
summary.en: In Oromia rural land disputes, where an occupant has held and cultivated land continuously and peacefully for 12 or more years, any recovery or restitution suit is definitively barred by limitation.

principle.om: Seerri hariiroo hawaasaa Kwt 1677(1) seeronni addaa dursi akka qabaatan kan ajaju waan ta'eef, Dambiin 151/2005 Kwt 32 darbiinsa yeroo waggaa 12 qofa dirqisiisa.
principle.en: Under Civil Code Art. 1677(1), specific legislation supersedes general code; Oromia Regulation 151/2005 Art. 32 strictly bars recovery actions after 12 years.

keyArticles.om: Dambii 151/2005 Kwt 32, Seera Hariiroo Hawaasaa Kwt 1677(1)

title.om: Murtii Dhaddacha Ijibbaataa & Qajeelfama Haaraa (Post #3428 - Latest Index)
title.en: Latest Cassation Binding Precedent & Digital Court Directives (Post #3428)

summary.om: Qajeeltoo seeraa dirqisiisaa MMWF & MMWO post #3428 irratti maxxanfame; raawwii murtii dijitaalaa, ragaa sagalee fi barreeffama elektiroonikii, fi adeemsa falmii manneen murtii.
summary.en: Latest Federal Supreme Court Cassation Binding Ratio (Post #3428). Electronic evidence admissibility, remote digital hearing protocols, and updated procedure execution.

principle.om: Bu'uura Labsii 1332/2016 fi Murtii Ijibbaataa #3428 tiin ragaan sagalee fi barreeffamni elektiroonikii dhaddacha seeraa keessatti fudhatama guutuu qaba.
principle.en: Pursuant to Proclamation 1332/2024 and Cassation Ratio #3428, electronic records and authenticated audio transcripts hold conclusive evidentiary weight.

keyArticles.en: Proclamation 1332/2024 Art. 12, Civil Procedure Code Art. 277

title.om: Mirga Wabiin Bahuu fi Daangaa Seeraa (Post #128 - Galmee 130896)
title.en: Bail Rights & Statutory Restrictions in Criminal Proceedings (Telegram Post #128 - File 130896)

summary.om: Galmee #130896 (Post #128): Himatamaan yakkaan shakkame hundi mirga wabiin bahuu qaba; daangaan kan kaa'amu seeraan qofa. Hiikoon seeraa dhaddacha ijibbaataatiin kennamee jira. Sakatta'iinsi gadi fagoon itti fufeera.
summary.en: File #130896 (Telegram Post #128): Accused persons enjoy a presumption of entitlement to bail unless restricted on clear statutory grounds. Binding legal precedent issued by the cassation bench. Detailed audit in progress.

principle.om: Heera RDFI Kwt 19(6) bu'uura godhachuun wabiin mirga bu'uuraati; manni murtii sababa malee hin kuffisu.
principle.en: Under FDRE Const. Art. 19(6), bail is a constitutional right requiring compelling judicial reasons for denial.

keyArticles.en: FDRE Const. Art. 19(6), Crim. Proc. Code Art. 63

title.en: Partition of Inherited Rural Land Holdings (Telegram Post #3427 - File 153989)

summary.om: Galmee #153989 (Post #3427): Ijoolleen abbaa irraa lafa dhaalan qixxee qooddachuu mirga qabu; kessumaa dubartoonni loogiin irra gahuu hin qabu. Hiikoon seeraa dhaddacha ijibbaataatiin kennamee jira. Sakatta'iinsi gadi fagoon itti fufeera.
summary.en: File #153989 (Telegram Post #3427): Children inheriting land from parents have equal partition rights; specifically, women must not face discrimination. Binding legal precedent issued by the cassation bench. Detailed audit in progress.

principle.om: Labsii 130/1999 Kwt 8 bu'uura godhachuun dhaalli lafaa ijoollee hundaaf qixxeedha.
principle.en: Under Oromia Proclamation 130/2007 Art. 8, land inheritance is equal for all descendants.
